conditions: Every targeted opponent must decline (or be unable) to pay Smothering Tithe's {2} tax on every relevant draw - an opponent choice this deck does not control.
Requires at least 3 opponents for the cycle to be strictly mana-positive; at exactly 2 opponents it is mana-neutral (break-even).
name: Faerie Mastermind + Smothering Tithe + Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy -> repeatable draw/mana engine

prerequisites.mana_available: {3}{U} per activation of Faerie Mastermind's 'Each player draws a card' ability.
prerequisites.timing: Any time the controller has priority and can pay {3}{U}.
other: Only ONE Smothering Tithe here (no Clever Impersonator copy), but Kinnan doubles the mana from each Treasure cracked: per INT-0013's already-established mechanism, Kinnan's 'Whenever you tap a nonland permanent for mana, add one mana of any type that permanent produced' is itself a triggered mana ability (CR 605.1b) that fires when a Treasure (a nonland permanent) is tapped+sacrificed for mana - each Treasure therefore yields 2 mana (1 base + 1 Kinnan-granted), not 1.
PER-CYCLE ARITHMETIC: cost = {3}{U} = 4 mana flat. With O opponents declining Smothering Tithe: income = O Treasures x 2 mana each (with Kinnan) = 2*O mana if all are cracked. Net = 2*O - 4.

At O=2: net = 0 (break-even). At O=3 (Spellbook's stated minimum, also a standard 4-player pod): net = +2 per cycle - genuinely unbounded, matching Spellbook's own stated threshold exactly (no correction needed here, unlike INT-0001).

Alternative bookkeeping: cracking only enough Treasures to exactly cover {3}{U} (2 Treasures x 2 mana = 4) leaves any additional Treasures from that cycle's O opponents banked uncracked - a growing Treasure count even when mana is spent to exactly zero surplus each cycle.
Faerie Mastermind's own passive 'second card' trigger is bounded (once per opponent per turn) - see INT-0001's note; the unbounded engine here is entirely the repeated {3}{U} activation.

result.summary: With exactly 2 opponents (declining every Tithe trigger): mana-neutral repeatable 'each player draws a card' engine, no accumulating mana. With 3+ opponents (all declining): net +2 mana per cycle - genuinely unbounded accumulating mana, matching Commander Spellbook's own stated 3-opponent threshold.
result.loop_termination: Voluntary; requires the stated opponent-decline condition on every iteration, and at least 3 opponents for the accumulating-mana case.

rules_citations: CR 605.1b - Kinnan's trigger meets the criteria for a triggered mana ability (see INT-0013).
CR 605.4 / 605.4a - triggered mana abilities resolve immediately without using the stack.
CR 603.2c - each Tithe-bearing permanent's own ability triggers independently.
